description: This file defines the ProductService interface, specifying methods for managing products, including adding descriptions, retrieving products by various criteria, and listing products within a store context.

classes.name: ProductService
classes.description: Interface for product-related operations within the store, extending generic entity service functionalities.

methods.name: addProductDescription
methods.description: Associates a description with a specific product, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: getProductDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the product description for a given product in a specific language.

methods.name: getProductForLocale
methods.description: Fetches a product tailored for a specific locale and language, identified by productId.

methods.name: getProductsForLocale
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products within a category for a particular locale and language.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves products based on a list of category IDs.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists products available in a specific store filtered by product criteria.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a product entity.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all products in a store without filtering.

methods.name: listByTaxClass
methods.description: Lists products associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves products by category IDs and language, throws ServiceException on failure.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a product based on its SEO URL within a store and locale.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a product by its SKU or code in a specific language.
